subject: NOTICE OF ASSIGNMENT OF ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE - COBALT FREIGHT LLC
text:
TO: Accounts Payable, Northgate Manufacturing Inc

RE: Cobalt Freight LLC (the "Seller")

Please be advised that Cobalt Freight LLC has sold and assigned all of its present and future accounts receivable to Harbor Capital Funding, LLC ("Harbor") pursuant to a Factoring and Security Agreement dated October 15, 2026.

Payment of all invoices issued by Cobalt Freight LLC, whether dated before or after this notice, must now be made ONLY to Harbor at the following address or bank account:

Harbor Capital Funding, LLC
P.O. Box 41177
Dallas, TX 75241

ACH / Wire:
Frost Bank
ABA 114000093
Account 1700228836
Beneficiary: Harbor Capital Funding LLC

Payment to any other party, including Cobalt Freight LLC directly, will not discharge your obligation. This notice may only be revoked in writing by Harbor.

Please sign and return the enclosed acknowledgment.

Harbor Capital Funding, LLC
Portfolio Operations

note: Factoring notice: a third party instructs the reader to pay the vendor's invoices to the factor's account. Redirects where the money lands.
